capabilities: Replace the view header in daily notes with a navigation bar
Change weeks with left and right buttons
Customize how dates are formatted in the settings tab
extras: The README lists CSS class names (daily-note-navbar and variants) for custom styling, but gives no screenshots or usage examples; contact is via the plugin's GitHub page.
intentEvidence: This plugin replaces the view header in daily notes files with a navbar.
motivation: The author saw a similar navbar at the top of daily notes in RemNote and thought it was neat.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to move between consecutive daily notes other than switching or searching for each file manually.

relations.evidence: I saw a navbar at the top of daily notes in RemNote and thought it was neat.

summary: Daily note navigation bar that replaces the view header in daily notes with links to previous, next and surrounding daily notes.
